name: VBGS (Variational Bayesian Gaussian Splatting)
aliases: Variational Bayes Gaussian Splatting (VBGS) Image Rendering
definition: VBGS represents a distribution over Gaussian Mixture Model parameters using a Normal-Inverse-Wishart likelihood for color, position, and Dirichlet prior, requiring 29 parameters per component compared to 14 in gradient baselines.
